rules: Every prompt pointer of field-statement-map.json and every enum or const value of compiler-prompt.schema.json is one construct below. The builder fails if any construct has no Rust form, if a pointer matches several forms, or if a form matches no construct.

owner names the issue that delivers the Rust form for each prompt version: phase1 is the delivered phase 1 output (#46 to #51); #53 owns capability products (v5 with capabilities, v6, and the non-flow part of v7); #54 owns v7 flows. A v5 construct outside the capabilities block belongs to phase 1 for a product without capabilities and to #53 for a product with capabilities.
A Rust form that says 'as Python' or 'the Python ...' means the same observable result as the accepted Python product for the same prompt under the phase 2 behavior suite (behavior.json).

The crates and their versions and features for MongoDB, authentication, object storage, workflows and flows are fixed by #53 in a later numbered amendment, under the toolchain rules of toolchain.json.

RS256 bearer tokens checked with JWT_PUBLIC_KEY_FILE, JWT_ISSUER and JWT_AUDIENCE; RSA keys of at least 2048 bits; claims sub, iat, exp, iss and aud; role=editor for writes; the Python 401 and 403 answers.

MongoDB with the driver chosen by #53. Requires a replica set or mongos as Python does. Collections are the prompt tables; integer ids come from _som_counters and revisions from _som_revision as in Python (naming.json W6). Unique and query indexes, transactions, and errors as Python.
PostgreSQL through sqlx as in phase 1, with the capability product tables of the Python migration (for v7 also _som_flow_runs and _som_flow_leases with the Python columns, naming.json W6).
GCS objects in GCS_BUCKET of GCS_PROJECT with application default credentials; STORAGE_EMULATOR_HOST as a test-only loopback override. The same /objects rules as s3.
The /objects routes and answers of the Python product without an object store.

S3 objects in S3_BUCKET with the SDK credential chain and AWS_REGION (default us-east-1); SOM_TEST_S3_ENDPOINT as a test-only loopback override with path-style addressing. PUT, GET and DELETE /objects/{key}: safe keys of 1 to 80 characters, at most 1 MiB, SHA-256 on PUT, same-body retry safe, a different body gives 409.
The CSV export with the Python bytes, and POST <parent path>/{parent_id}/import with text/csv: 1 to 20 rows, headers equal to the custom child fields, \N for null, all rows or none.

GET <parent path>/{parent_id}/export: up to 1000 children in id order, 413 above; the Python media type, headers and bytes.
